entries.title: RevenueRoles
entries.summary: Job discovery for technical revenue roles such as GTM engineer, RevOps engineer, and forward deployed engineer, classified by the work a posting describes rather than by its title.

entries.title: Shiksha-Mitra
entries.summary: A collaborative learning platform where peers share resources, acknowledge progress, and support each other's career and education journeys.

entries.title: The Open Framework
entries.summary: An early digital public infrastructure concept for civil-society coordination, published as a front-end prototype rather than as live national infrastructure.

entries.title: AGENYRA
entries.summary: A distribution layer for AI products, starting with structured representation and builder onboarding, with discovery and placement still at earlier stages.

entries.title: MedVoice
entries.summary: A voice-assisted order and billing workflow for pharmaceutical wholesalers, where speech proposes a line and deterministic rules decide identity, tax, and posting.

entries.title: Adaptive RAG
entries.summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation with LangGraph: query rewriting, relevance grading, web-search fallback, and routing between retrieval, search, and plain reasoning.

entries.title: MailU
entries.summary: Local email intelligence: Gmail API sync, zero-shot categorization, semantic search, and RAG chat over your own mail on a local model.

entries.title: OpenAI-RLHF
entries.summary: An archive of coding-evaluation tasks with a task generator, test runner, and validation tooling. It is not an RLHF trainer.

entries.title: RLHF-tasks
entries.summary: Coding-agent evaluation toolchain: Harbor and Terminus task systems, Dockerized oracles, and review CLIs.

entries.title: GTM engineering
entries.summary: Data and decision systems for revenue work: job-market data pipelines, entity resolution, explainable scoring, and human-approval workflows. The page covers RevenueRoles, the Revenue Intelligence Engine, the Relationship Intelligence Engine, SpiderWeb, and MailU, and separates what I have built from what I am still learning.

entries.title: security-audit
entries.summary: Read-only, cross-platform host audit toolkit with DFIR-style inventory and MITRE-mapped findings.

entries.title: IAS-system
entries.summary: Judgment and case-file audit pipeline: OCR, SOP checks, then scoring.

entries.title: amex
entries.summary: Interpretable business analytics: constrained P&L scoring instead of proxy-target machine learning.

entries.title: Public policy work in 2025
entries.summary: GCTP 2025, about five drafted policy proposals on geopolitical contexts in India and city development, a review of government schemes, and a three-day public policy challenge.

entries.title: A book
entries.summary: I am writing a book. The subject and timing will be shared when it is ready.

entries.title: A long-running application
entries.summary: An application I have been building over roughly six to seven years. It is in development and not public yet.
